photos.desc: This brook (Bosbeek) is used in a reintroduction program for burbot ( Lota lota ) in Flanders, Belgium. The young fish live in holes in the brook's banks.
Burbot collected in a trawl on the USGS R/V Sturgeon as part of a July 2015 Lake Michigan Cooperative Science and Monitoring Initiative (CSMI) research. Credit: NOAA
Burbot (Lota lota) photographed at Gavins Point National Fish Hatchery in Yankton, South Dakota. Photo: Sam Stukel/USFWS
Burbot ( Lota lota ), Batchawana Bay , Lake Superior
